feature: Deck state — the facet that filters on the marks
note: The two rows of the `Deck state` heading, in both renderings: a `FilterPanel` in the wide chassis and a chip group in the phone sheet. No `shares` block, deliberately — the wide form and the sheet are two components by design (`decks-view.tsx` mounts the panel, `deck-filter-sheet.tsx` draws chips), which is the same split every other facet on this route already has, so a binding here would fail a correct build. What a picture adds over the tests: the heading sits directly after Status in the wide row, and the row does not wrap with a fifth control in it — `probe:deck-state-marks` measures the wrap, this shows the placement. Same /about precondition as the marks inventory.
